title: Rotate leaked Appwrite API key + remove in-code default
description:
application.yml line 94 ships a real Appwrite server API key as a fallback default (${APPWRITE_API_KEY:<literal>}). The key is in git history, so deleting the literal does NOT unleak it.

ACTIONS:
1. Rotate/regenerate the Appwrite server API key in the Appwrite console (the committed key is compromised the moment it entered git; it is sent as X-Appwrite-Key on every token validation).
2. Remove the in-code default so the placeholder is ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback - app must fail at startup if unset (production should refuse to boot rather than run with a phantom key).
3. Store the new key only in .env / deployment secrets (already gitignored; verified .env, .env.dev, docker/development/.env are in .gitignore and not tracked).
4. OPTIONAL/heavier: history scrub (git filter-repo/BFG). Not required - rotation makes the leaked key worthless.

Context: security-module rewrite for Spring Boot 4. Dev profile never calls Appwrite, so dev does not need the key. endpoint + project_id keeping defaults is acceptable; a secret key must not.
close_reason: Code-side fix landed in commit 8a60702. application.yml + application.yml (test) now have ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback — app will fail at startup if the env var is unset. ./gradlew compileJava compileTestJava → BUILD SUCCESSFUL. The literal key still lives in the gitignored .env, .env.dev, .env.migrate files; user must rotate the key in the Appwrite console and update those 3 files with the new value before next deploy. History scrub explicitly noted as optional by the issue and not required once the key is rotated.

title: Author 32 missing non-master Flyway migrations + Envers REVINFO/_AUD so app boots (CQRS rewrite)
description: App cannot start on branch rewrite/master-cqrs: ddl-auto=none means Hibernate validates entities against the Flyway schema, but only master (V1) + 16 reference tables (V2) exist. 32 non-master entity tables are missing, AND no REVINFO/_AUD tables exist anywhere despite 8 V2 reference entities + ~21 missing entities being @Audited (spring-data-envers on classpath). Acceptance oracle: Hibernate 'validate' under MariaDBDialect passes on a DB built purely by Flyway. Scope = 62 new objects (1 REVINFO + 32 entity tables + 29 _AUD). First step: switch application.yml dialect MySQLDialect->MariaDBDialect. Delete orphaned V4 and fold status VARCHAR(32) into gaji_batch_root CREATE. Full content plan in design field. Do NOT modify entity Java; schema mirrors entities as-is. Created by grill (senior-dev/manager review); execution delegated to another agent.
design:
# Plan — Author Missing Non-Master Flyway Migrations (CQRS rewrite)

Branch: `rewrite/master-cqrs`. You are writing the migrations that another agent (this grill) deliberately did NOT write. Goal: make the app BOOT though the rewrite is incomplete. The app currently cannot start: `ddl-auto: none`, so Hibernate validates the live entity model against the Flyway schema and FAILS — only `master` + 16 reference tables exist, every other module's table is missing.

## Acceptance oracle (the ONLY definition of done)

Hibernate schema `validate` under **MariaDBDialect** passes on a DB built purely by Flyway. There is no other oracle. Do not eyeball; let Hibernate validate.

1. **FIRST checkpoint, before writing any SQL:** in `src/main/resources/application.yml:34` change `dialect: org.hibernate.dialect.MySQLDialect` → `org.hibernate.dialect.MariaDBDialect`. All column types below are chosen to satisfy MariaDBDialect's `validate`.
2. Build the schema from scratch with Flyway, set `ddl-auto: validate` temporarily (or run the app), confirm zero validation errors. Revert `ddl-auto` to `none` when green.

## Scope — 62 new objects (NOT 32)

`validate` also validates Envers `_AUD` tables and `REVINFO`. Current migrations (V1–V4) create **zero** `_AUD` and **no REVINFO**, yet V2 already created 8 `@Audited` reference tables. So the missing set is larger than the 32 entity tables:

| Bucket | Count | What |
|---|---|---|
| REVINFO | 1 | Envers revision table (built-in defaults) |
| `_AUD` backfill for V2's already-existing audited refs | 8 | tables exist, `_AUD` siblings missing |
| New entity tables | 32 | the missing non-master tables |
| New `_AUD` for the 32 | 21 | 20 class-level + 1 partial (gaji_batch_root) |
| **Total** | **62** | |

V1 master entities are NOT audited — no `_AUD` backfill for master.

## File layout — per-module, FK order (REVINFO first)

Create under `src/main/resources/db/migration/`. Within each file: any `_AUD` table goes AFTER its base table; REVINFO is global and comes first overall.

- `V5_0_0__create_revinfo.sql` — REVINFO only.
- `V5_0_1__create_profil.sql` — biodata, kartu_identitas, keahlian, lampiran_profil, pelatihan, pendidikan, pengalaman_kerja, ProfilKeluarga, ProfilUpdate (+ their `_AUD`).
- `V5_0_2__create_pegawai.sql` — pegawai (+ pegawai_AUD).
- `V5_0_3__create_kepegawaian.sql` — lampiran_sk, riwayat_cuti, riwayat_keluar, riwayat_kontrak, riwayat_mutasi, riwayat_sk, riwayat_sp, riwayat_terminasi, statistik_pegawai (+ `_AUD` for audited ones).
- `V5_0_4__create_cuti.sql` — cuti_approval, cuti_approval_chain, cuti_klaim_detail, cuti_kuota, cuti_pegawai (+ `_AUD` for audited ones).
- `V5_0_5__create_penggajian.sql` — gaji_batch_master, gaji_batch_master_proses, gaji_batch_potongan_tkk, gaji_batch_root, gaji_batch_root_error_logs, gaji_batch_root_lampiran, gaji_phdp (+ gaji_batch_root_AUD partial). **ALSO put the 8 V2-ref `_AUD` backfill here** (dasar_gaji_AUD, detail_dasar_gaji_AUD, gaji_komponen_AUD, gaji_parameter_setting_AUD, gaji_pendapatan_non_pajak_AUD, gaji_potongan_tkk_AUD, gaji_profil_AUD, gaji_tunjangan_AUD) — base tables already exist from V2.
- `V5_0_6__create_master_hari_libur.sql` — hari_libur (not audited).

FK order rationale (verified against `@ManyToOne/@OneToOne`): profil tables depend only on V2 refs (JenjangPendidikan, JenisKitas, JenisKeahlian, JenisPelatihan) + Biodata; pegawai depends on Biodata + V1/V2 master refs (Golongan, Grade, Jabatan, Organisasi, Profesi, GajiProfil, GajiPendapatanNonPajak, RumahDinas); kepegawaian + cuti depend on Pegawai (+ RiwayatSk self-order within kepegawaian: riwayat_sk before riwayat_mutasi/riwayat_terminasi); penggajian tables have no cross-module FK; hari_libur standalone.

## Delete V4, fold into CREATE

Delete `V4__gaji_status_to_varchar.sql` — it ALTERs `gaji_batch_root` which no migration creates, so on a fresh Flyway DB it fails. Instead, in `gaji_batch_root` CREATE define `status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL` directly (entity: `@Enumerated(STRING) @Column(nullable=false,length=32)`).

## House style (copy V1_0_0__create_master.sql exactly)

For entities extending `MasterBaseEntity` (audit columns inherited):
```
id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
... business columns ...,
is_deleted BIT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0',
created_by VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
updated_by VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME(6) DEFAULT NULL ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
INDEX idx_<table>_is_deleted (is_deleted)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
```
FK columns nullable, `FOREIGN KEY (...) REFERENCES ... ON DELETE SET NULL`. Add the entity's own `@Index`/`@Table(indexes=...)` declarations as INDEX clauses (e.g. gaji_batch_root has 7).

NOTE: not every entity extends MasterBaseEntity — READ each entity file. Some (e.g. GajiBatchRoot, Biodata) declare their own audit fields / `@Id` / `columnDefinition` directly. `columnDefinition` is verbatim-authoritative; honor it over the crib (e.g. GajiBatchRoot.notes → `TEXT`; GajiBatchRoot.isDeleted has `columnDefinition="boolean default false"` → MariaDB renders BIT(1)/tinyint — let validate confirm).

## Type crib (MariaDBDialect)

Long→BIGINT · Integer→INT · Boolean→BIT(1) · String→VARCHAR(255) or @Column(length) · @Lob/large text→LONGTEXT, columnDefinition TEXT→TEXT · LocalDateTime→DATETIME(6) · LocalDate→DATE · BigDecimal→DECIMAL(p,s) per @Column(precision,scale) · @Enumerated(STRING)→VARCHAR(len) else INT (ordinal). Derive every non-inherited column by reading the entity field + its annotations. Do NOT guess column lists — read the .java.

## Envers `_AUD` / REVINFO rules (built-in defaults — config is COMMENTED in application.yml:36-42)

- Suffix `_AUD`, revision col `REV`, type col `REVTYPE`. AuditRevisionListener commented → REVINFO has ONLY the two default columns.
- **REVINFO**: `REV INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, REVTSTMP BIGINT`. (No username/action columns.)
- **Class-level `@Audited` table** `X_AUD`: all of X's persistent columns, PLUS `REV INTEGER NOT NULL`, `REVTYPE TINYINT`. Composite PK `(REV, <X's pk>)`. FK `REV → REVINFO(REV)`. `_AUD` tables carry NO `is_deleted`/audit-FK constraints to other `_AUD`; they mirror columns but relax FKs (Envers does not FK business columns). Keep `_AUD` columns nullable except the PK pair. Let `validate` dictate exact nullability — it checks column presence/type, build minimal and iterate.
- **Field-level `@Audited`** (gaji_batch_root ONLY): `gaji_batch_root_AUD` = `id` (PK part) + `updated_by` + `is_deleted` + `REV` + `REVTYPE`. PK `(REV, id)`. NOTHING else.
- `@Audited(targetAuditMode=NOT_AUDITED)` (Biodata, and the V2 refs detail_dasar_gaji/gaji_komponen/gaji_potongan_tkk/gaji_profil/gaji_tunjangan): entity IS audited (gets `_AUD`); only its relations are not. Treat as normal class-level `_AUD`.

### `_AUD` inventory (authoritative — from source scan)

CLASS-LEVEL @Audited among the 32 (→ full `_AUD`, 20): cuti_approval, cuti_kuota, cuti_pegawai, lampiran_sk, riwayat_cuti, riwayat_kontrak, riwayat_mutasi, riwayat_sk, riwayat_sp, riwayat_terminasi, pegawai, gaji_phdp, biodata, kartu_identitas, keahlian, lampiran_profil, pelatihan, pendidikan, pengalaman_kerja, ProfilKeluarga.

FIELD-LEVEL @Audited (→ partial `_AUD`, 1): gaji_batch_root.

NOT audited among the 32 (→ NO `_AUD`, 11): cuti_approval_chain, cuti_klaim_detail, riwayat_keluar, statistik_pegawai, hari_libur, gaji_batch_master, gaji_batch_master_proses, gaji_batch_potongan_tkk, gaji_batch_root_error_logs, gaji_batch_root_lampiran, ProfilUpdate.

V2-ref `_AUD` BACKFILL (base table exists, add `_AUD`, 8): dasar_gaji, detail_dasar_gaji, gaji_komponen, gaji_parameter_setting, gaji_pendapatan_non_pajak, gaji_potongan_tkk, gaji_profil, gaji_tunjangan. (Read each entity for column list; their base tables are in V2.)

## Table-name overrides (verbatim — affects table AND `_AUD` name)

- `ProfilKeluarga` entity → table `ProfilKeluarga` (mixed-case) → `_AUD` = `ProfilKeluarga_AUD`.
- `ProfileUpdate` entity → table `ProfilUpdate` (mixed-case, NOT audited → no `_AUD`).
- `pegawai`, `gaji_batch_root_lampiran` → explicit but equal to default snake_case.
- All others: Hibernate default snake_case of class name.

## Special cases

- **Biodata**: `@Id private String nik` (assigned String PK, NOT Long IDENTITY — no AUTO_INCREMENT); `@Version private Long version = 1L` → `version BIGINT`. Class-level `@Audited(targetAuditMode=NOT_AUDITED)`. `biodata` PK = `nik VARCHAR(...)` (read @Column for length, default 255/16 — verify). `biodata_AUD` PK = `(REV, nik)`. FK targets: JenjangPendidikan (V2).
- **GajiBatchRoot**: `@Id private String id` (assigned String, no @GeneratedValue → no AUTO_INCREMENT); declares its OWN audit fields (createdBy/createdAt/updatedBy/updatedAt/isDeleted) NOT via MasterBaseEntity; `status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL`; `notes TEXT`; 7 indexes. Two `@OneToMany(mappedBy=...)` → NO FK column on this table (FK lives on child gaji_batch_root_lampiran / gaji_batch_root_error_logs). `gaji_batch_root_AUD` partial as above.
- Entities with assigned (non-generated) String PKs get NO AUTO_INCREMENT. Most others extend MasterBaseEntity → `id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT`.

## Out of scope

- `pref_role` (V2, seed-only, no entity) — already exists, leave alone.
- V3 seed files, V1, V2 — do not touch (except: delete V4).
- Do NOT change entity Java. Schema must mirror entities AS-IS.
- Do NOT enable the commented Envers/schema-gen blocks in application.yml.

## Definition of done checklist

- [ ] application.yml:34 → MariaDBDialect.
- [ ] V4 deleted; status folded into gaji_batch_root CREATE as VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL.
- [ ] V5_0_0..V5_0_6 created; 62 objects total (1 REVINFO + 32 tables + 29 `_AUD`).
- [ ] Fresh Flyway build + Hibernate `validate` under MariaDBDialect → 0 errors.
- [ ] `ddl-auto` reverted to `none`.
- [ ] App boots (`./gradlew bootRun`, dev profile).
- [ ] Quality gates + session-close protocol (git push, bd dolt push).

GajiBatchRoot: processPotonganTkk di dalam tx save() — tx terlalu panjang, proses berat
description:
P1: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.save() line 55-60 @Transactional, lalu di dalam body line 83 panggil processPotonganTkk.process(...). Tanpa melihat source processPotonganTkk, nama 'process' (suffix Process, bukan Query) mengindikasikan write/calculation yang berat. Bila process() ini query banyak row (potongan × N pegawai) atau write tabel lain, transaksi save() jadi sangat panjang — lock contention, batch lain ke-block, slow rollback kalau ada error.

Dampak: lock DB contention, slow response (bisa menit), connection pool exhausted, observability sulit (tx span sangat besar).

Detail implementasi perbaikan:
- Pecah jadi dua fase: (1) commit row GajiBatchRoot minimal (status=DRAFT), (2) panggil processPotonganTkk di afterCommit atau scheduler async, (3) update status=COMPLETED saat selesai.
- Atau: pakai @Transactional(propagation = REQUIRES_NEW) di process() — biar tx save() commit duluan, process() punya tx sendiri. trade-off: 2 round-trip DB.
- Audit: baca processPotonganTkk.process() dulu (via gitnexus_context) untuk tahu apa yang sebenarnya dilakukan. Kalau murni read, bisa di luar tx (di save()). Kalau write, butuh REQUIRES_NEW.
- Log timing: log.info('processPotonganTkk took {}ms', elapsed) untuk observability.

Acceptance:
- save() tx tidak lebih dari ~100ms (kecuali ada network I/O file upload — lihat kepegawaian-0fe)
- processPotonganTkk berjalan terpisah, bisa di-retry kalau gagal
- Lock test: 2 batch concurrent tidak saling tunggu

title: GajiBatchRoot.save(): hasil kafkaTemplate.send() diabaikan — kegagalan kirim senyap
description:
GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.save() baris 81 memanggil kafkaTemplate.send(PENGGAJIAN_TOPIC, save.getId()) tanpa menangani CompletableFuture yang dikembalikan. send() bersifat async/non-blocking: jika broker down, metadata timeout, atau serialisasi gagal, error muncul di future dan TIDAK terlihat. Method tetap return ESaveStatus.SUCCESS padahal pesan trigger penggajian tidak pernah terkirim — batch tersimpan di DB tapi proses hilir tidak pernah jalan (silent data loss).

Dampak: batch gaji 'sukses' tapi tidak diproses; sulit dideteksi karena tidak ada log error.

Konteks (Spring Kafka docs via context7): send() mengembalikan CompletableFuture<SendResult>. Pola yang benar:
  kafkaTemplate.send(topic, id).whenComplete((result, ex) -> { if (ex != null) { /* log + tandai batch FAILED / simpan ke GajiBatchRootErrorLogs */ } });

Rekomendasi implementasi:
1. Tangkap future dari send(), daftarkan whenComplete callback.
2. Pada ex != null: log error, dan persist kegagalan (entity GajiBatchRootErrorLogs sudah ada) atau set status batch ke FAILED agar bisa di-reprocess.
3. Pertimbangkan pola transactional outbox jika konsistensi DB+Kafka kritikal (lihat issue terkait dual-write).

Lokasi: src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/services/penggajian/gajiBatchRoot/GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:81 dan reprocessHandler() baris 166. Tidak perlu rewrite sekarang — issue ini untuk agent implementor.

title: F6.S2: Migrasi klien Appwrite WebClient -> RestClient (drop webflux)
design:
Patuhi WORKING AGREEMENT epic 5x7 (gitnexus dulu, context7 dulu, DRY/KISS, SCOPE KETAT).

TUJUAN: Hilangkan WebFlux. Ganti WebClient (reactive) dengan Spring RestClient (sinkron) untuk panggilan Appwrite. Sekaligus perbaiki semantik error yang sekarang ditelan jadi null.

context7 WAJIB: Spring Framework 7 `RestClient` — builder/baseUrl, `.get().uri(...).header(...).retrieve().body(Class)`, dan penanganan status `.onStatus(HttpStatusCode::is4xxClientError, ...)` / 5xx. Pastikan paket & API.

gitnexus WAJIB: gitnexus_context untuk JwtTokenService + WebClientConfig + AuthController; gitnexus_impact({direction:"upstream"}) pada JwtTokenService SEBELUM edit — WARN bila HIGH/CRITICAL (filter auth bergantung padanya).

FILE (SCOPE KETAT):
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/WebClientConfig.java -> jadikan RestClientConfig: bean RestClient (RestClient.builder().baseUrl(${appwrite.endpoint}).build()). Rename file/kelas via gitnexus_rename, BUKAN find-replace.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/security/JwtTokenService.java -> pakai RestClient. getUserFromToken(): GET {endpoint}/account/jwt + header X-Appwrite-Project / X-Appwrite-Key / X-Appwrite-JWT, body -> AppwriteUser.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/controllers/auth/AuthController.java -> /auth/session pakai RestClient (bukan WebClient). HAPUS endpoint /auth/csrf-token (CSRF dibuang di rewrite security; RedisHelper.generateToken tak dipakai lagi di sini).

SEMANTIK ERROR (perbaikan inti, jangan dilewat):
- Lama: try/catch menelan SEMUA error jadi null -> semua tampak 401. SALAH.
- Baru: pakai .onStatus. Token ditolak Appwrite (401/403) -> lempar yang dipetakan ke 401 Unauthorized. Appwrite tak terjangkau / 5xx / timeout -> petakan ke 503 Service Unavailable. Jangan kembalikan null buta.

DRY/KISS: satu bean RestClient dipakai bersama. Jangan bikin wrapper/abstraksi tambahan. Jangan retry/circuit-breaker (di luar scope — buat issue baru bila perlu).

ANTI-SLOP: jangan menambah DTO baru selain yang sudah ada (AppwriteUser/Prefs). Jangan ubah signature publik JwtTokenService kecuali perlu untuk membedakan 401 vs 503.

Alur tutup: gitnexus_detect_changes() -> hanya 3 file di atas + rename -> ./gradlew compileJava -> bd close.
acceptance_criteria: Tidak ada lagi import org.springframework.web.reactive.* di kode app; JWT valid -> AppwriteUser ter-resolve; token salah -> 401; Appwrite mati -> 503 (bukan 401); kompilasi hijau tanpa webflux.

Sisanya BIARKAN VERBATIM: bean openAPI() (scheme global HTTP/bearer/JWT "BearerAuthentication" + .security(...)) dan ke-10 bean GroupedOpenApi (masterApi /master/**, profileApi /profil/**, pegawaiApi /pegawai/**, kepegawaianApi /kepegawaian/**, penggajianApi /penggajian/**, userApi /auth/**, systemApi /system/**, laporanKepegawaianApi /laporan/kepegawaian/**, cutiApi /cuti/**). design:
Buat artefak kontrak bersama yang dipakai SEMUA endpoint master. Dibangun sebelum endpoint apa pun.

design:
Rewrite modul `master` dari nol ke arsitektur baru. Bahasa TETAP Java; hanya build script jadi build.gradle.kts. Lightweight CQRS: JPA sisi tulis, JOOQ sisi baca, satu MariaDB. Cakupan entity master (17 entity + 5 enum read-only):
- Flat: Golongan, Level, JenjangPendidikan, JenisKeahlian, JenisPelatihan, JenisKitas, AlasanBerhenti, RumahDinas, HariLibur
- Tree self-ref: Organisasi, Jabatan, Grade
- Aggregate: Profesi (APD & AlatKerja dilipat ke dalamnya)

- Enum read-only: StatusKerja, StatusPegawai, JenisKontrak, JenisMutasi, JenisSk

=== WORKING AGREEMENT (BERLAKU UNTUK SEMUA CHILD ISSUE) ===
1. PAHAMI DULU lewat gitnexus sebelum ngoding: `gitnexus_query`/`gitnexus_context` untuk mengerti perilaku kode lama yang ditiru. Jalankan `gitnexus_impact({direction:"upstream"})` SEBELUM mengedit symbol apa pun; WARN bila risiko HIGH/CRITICAL.
2. CEK context7 untuk API library SEBELUM menulis (Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7, Spring Security 7, JOOQ, Flyway, Hibernate). Pengetahuan internal bisa basi. [SKIP context7 untuk: refactor murni, biz-logic, code review.]
3. DRY + KISS. Jangan over-engineer, jangan bikin abstraksi yang tak diminta, jangan command/query bus (ADR-0001), jangan interface+Impl — pakai concrete @Service (ADR-0007). 3 baris mirip lebih baik daripada abstraksi prematur.
4. SCOPE KETAT — kurangi AI Slop: HANYA sentuh file yang disebut di issue. JANGAN mengubah/merapikan file lain. Bila butuh perubahan di luar scope, BUAT ISSUE BARU (`bd create --deps discovered-from:<id>`), jangan lakukan diam-diam.
5. Soft-delete only (is_deleted), jangan hard-delete. Endpoint mutasi WAJIB @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')").
6. Patuhi ADR yang dirujuk tiap issue (docs/adr/). Jangan langgar keputusan terkunci.
7. Alur: `bd update <id> --claim` sebelum mulai → ngoding → `gitnexus_detect_changes()` sebelum commit (pastikan hanya symbol yang diharapkan berubah) → `./gradlew test` → `bd close <id>`.

design:
# Level CQRS Migration — Implementation Plan (manager-authored)

Goal: bring `Level` master domain in line with ADR-0001 (CQRS) + ADR-0007 (no
interface+Impl) + ADR-0017 (repo subpackage layout). Replicate the **Golongan**
domain exactly — it is the canonical exemplar. Do NOT invent new patterns.

Reference files to copy the shape from (read these first, mirror them 1:1):
- services/master/golongan/GolonganCommandService.java
- services/master/golongan/GolonganQueryService.java
- repositories/master/jooq/GolonganQueryRepository.java
- mapper/master/golongan/GolonganMapper.java
- controllers/master/GolonganController.java
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganIndexQuery.java
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganQuery.java

Level differs from Golongan in ONE way: Golongan has 2 business columns
(golongan, pangkat); Level has 1 business column (`nama`). jOOQ table column is
`Level.LEVEL.NAMA`. Everywhere Golongan handles two filter fields, Level handles one.

IMPORTANT (per CLAUDE.md): run `gitnexus_impact({target, direction:"upstream"})`
before editing each symbol; use `gitnexus_rename` for the repo MOVES (NOT
find/replace); run `gitnexus_detect_changes()` before committing.

====================================================================
PHASE A — Move the 2 leaked JPA repos into repositories/master/jpa/
(mechanical, do first; independent of the CQRS work)
====================================================================

A1. Move repositories/master/LevelRepository.java
    → repositories/master/jpa/LevelRepository.java
    - Change package decl to `...repositories.master.jpa;`
    - Use gitnexus_rename so all importers update automatically.
    - 6 importers to verify update:
        services/master/level/LevelServiceImpl.java   (will be DELETED in Phase C — ignore)
        services/master/grade/GradeCommandService.java
        services/master/jabatan/JabatanCommandService.java
        services/penggajian/gajiPotonganTkk/GajiPotonganTkkServiceImpl.java
        services/penggajian/gajiTunjangan/GajiTunjanganServiceImpl.java
        services/setupMaster/SetupLevel.java
    - Optional consistency: make LevelRepository also extend
      RevisionRepository<Level, Long, Integer> like GolonganRepository. Only if
      Envers revision lookups are needed; otherwise leave as-is. Default: leave as-is.

A2. Move repositories/master/JenjangPendidikanRepository.java
    → repositories/master/jpa/JenjangPendidikanRepository.java
    - Change package decl to `...repositories.master.jpa;`
    - Use gitnexus_rename. 5 importers:
        services/master/jenjangPendidikan/JenjangPendidikanServiceImpl.java
        services/profil/biodata/BiodataServiceImpl.java
        services/profil/keluarga/ProfilKeluargaServiceImpl.java
        services/profil/pendidikan/PendidikanServiceImpl.java
        services/setupMaster/SetupJenjangPendidikan.java

A3. Verify after move:
        grep -rn 'repositories.master.LevelRepository'           src   → 0 results
        grep -rn 'repositories.master.JenjangPendidikanRepository' src → 0 results
        grep -rn 'repositories.master.jpa.LevelRepository'        src   → all importers
    Compile: ./gradlew compileJava

NOTE: Phase A alone is shippable and de-risks the batch refactor. It can be a
separate commit/PR from Phase B–C if reviewer prefers small diffs.

====================================================================
PHASE B — Build the Level CQRS read/write split (new files)
====================================================================

B1. NEW dto/master/level/LevelIndexQuery.java   (mirror GolonganIndexQuery)
    package ...dto.master.level;
    @EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true) @Data
    public class LevelIndexQuery extends CommonPageRequest {
        private String nama;
    }

B2. NEW dto/master/level/LevelQuery.java         (mirror GolonganQuery — read DTO)
    package ...dto.master.level;
    @Data
    public class LevelQuery {
        private Long id;
        private String nama;
    }

B3. NEW mapper/master/level/LevelMapper.java     (mirror GolonganMapper)
    final class, private ctor.
    static Level toEntity(LevelPostRequest request) { return new Level(request.getNama()); }
    static void updateEntity(Level entity, LevelPostRequest request) { entity.setNama(request.getNama()); }
    (Level already has the single-String ctor new Level(String nama).)

B4. NEW repositories/master/jooq/LevelQueryRepository.java  (mirror GolonganQueryRepository)
    @Repository @RequiredArgsConstructor, inject DSLContext dsl.
    import id.perumdamts.kepegawaian.jooq.tables.Level;   // jOOQ generated table
    Table ref: Level.LEVEL ; columns Level.LEVEL.ID, Level.LEVEL.NAMA, Level.LEVEL.IS_DELETED.
    - pageQuery(LevelIndexQuery query):
        sort whitelist switch: case "nama" -> Level.LEVEL.NAMA ; default -> Level.LEVEL.ID
        sortOrder asc/desc per query.getSortDirection()
        count: selectCount().from(Level.LEVEL).where(IS_DELETED.eq(false))
               .and(nama != null ? NAMA.likeIgnoreCase("%"+nama+"%") : DSL.noCondition())
        data: select(ID, NAMA).from(Level.LEVEL).where(IS_DELETED.eq(false))
               .and(same nama filter).orderBy(sortOrder).limit(size).offset(page*size)
               .fetchInto(LevelQuery.class)
        return new PageImpl<>(data, PageRequest.of(page,size), count)
    - getById(Long id): select(ID,NAMA).from(Level.LEVEL).where(ID.eq(id)).and(IS_DELETED.eq(false))
                        .fetchOptionalInto(LevelQuery.class)
    - listQuery(): select(ID,NAMA).from(Level.LEVEL).where(IS_DELETED.eq(false))
                   .orderBy(NAMA.asc()).fetchInto(LevelQuery.class)

B5. NEW services/master/level/LevelQueryService.java  (mirror GolonganQueryService)
    @Service @RequiredArgsConstructor, inject LevelQueryRepository.
    Page<LevelQuery> pageQuery(LevelIndexQuery q) -> queryRepository.pageQuery(q)
    LevelQuery getById(Long id) -> queryRepository.getById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException("Level not found"))
    List<LevelQuery> listQuery() -> queryRepository.listQuery()

B6. NEW services/master/level/LevelCommandService.java  (mirror GolonganCommandService)
    @Service @RequiredArgsConstructor, inject the MOVED jpa LevelRepository
    (repositories.master.jpa.LevelRepository). All methods @Transactional.
    - create(LevelPostRequest request):
        Optional<Level> existing = repository.findOne(request.getSpecification());
        if present & isDeleted -> revive (setIsDeleted(false), save, return);
        if present & not deleted -> throw new ConflictException("Level already exists");
        else -> save LevelMapper.toEntity(request), return.
    - update(Long id, LevelPostRequest request):
        existing = findById(id).orElseThrow(NotFoundException "Level not found");
        duplicate = findOne(request.getSpecification());
        if duplicate present & id mismatch -> throw ConflictException;
        LevelMapper.updateEntity(existing, request); save; return.
    - delete(Long id):
        existing = findById(id).orElseThrow(NotFoundException); setIsDeleted(true); save.
    - createBatch(List<LevelPostRequest> requests):   // see PHASE D decision
        repository.saveAll(LevelPostRequest.toEntities(requests));

====================================================================
PHASE C — Rewrite controller, delete the interface + Impl
====================================================================

C1. Rewrite controllers/master/LevelController.java to mirror GolonganController:
    inject `LevelQueryService query` + `LevelCommandService command`.
    - index(@ParameterObject LevelIndexQuery request) -> CustomResult.page(query.pageQuery(request))
    - /list -> CustomResult.list(query.listQuery())
    - /{id} -> CustomResult.any(query.getById(id))
    - POST save -> command.create(request); CustomResult.save(SavedStatus.build(SUCCESS, entity))
    - PUT /{id} -> command.update(id, request); CustomResult.save(SavedStatus.build(SUCCESS, entity))
    - DELETE /{id} -> command.delete(id); CustomResult.delete(true)
    - POST /batch -> see PHASE D.
    Keep all @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") on mutating endpoints. Keep @Valid + Errors guard.

C2. DELETE services/master/level/LevelService.java       (interface — ADR-0007 violation)
C3. DELETE services/master/level/LevelServiceImpl.java
    Run gitnexus_impact on LevelService + LevelServiceImpl FIRST to confirm
    the only caller was LevelController (now rewritten). LevelResponse/LevelRequest
    DTOs become unused after this — delete dto/master/level/LevelResponse.java and
    LevelRequest.java ONLY if grep confirms zero remaining references; otherwise keep.

====================================================================
PHASE D — Decision on the POST /master/level/batch endpoint
====================================================================

Golongan has NO /batch endpoint; Level does (saveBatch). MANAGER DECISION:
**Preserve /batch** — it is an existing public endpoint, removing it is a breaking
API change out of scope for an architecture refactor.
Implementation: add createBatch() to LevelCommandService (Phase B6) and keep the
controller endpoint, returning CustomResult.save(SavedStatus.build(SUCCESS, "Success Saving Batch Data")).
Do NOT add dup-revive logic to batch (matches current behavior — plain saveAll).
If a reviewer wants it gone, that is a separate ticket, not this one.

====================================================================
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
====================================================================
1. grep -rn 'repositories.master.LevelRepository'            src → 0
2. grep -rn 'repositories.master.JenjangPendidikanRepository' src → 0
3. No `interface LevelService` and no `LevelServiceImpl` remain.
4. LevelController injects LevelQueryService + LevelCommandService (no LevelService).
5. New files exist: LevelQueryRepository (jooq), LevelQueryService, LevelCommandService,
   LevelMapper, LevelIndexQuery, LevelQuery.
6. Read path goes through JOOQ DSLContext; write path through jpa LevelRepository.
7. ./gradlew clean build  → BUILD SUCCESSFUL (compile + tests pass).
8. gitnexus_detect_changes() shows only Level-domain + the 2 moved-repo importers affected.
9. Endpoints behave: GET /master/level (paged), /list, /{id}, POST, POST /batch, PUT /{id}, DELETE /{id}.

Suggested commit split:
  Commit 1 (Phase A): "refactor(master): move Level/JenjangPendidikan repos into jpa/ subpackage"
  Commit 2 (Phase B–D): "refactor(master): split Level into CQRS command/query (ADR-0001/0007/0017)"

description:
P2: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.delete() (line 165-174) TIDAK @Transactional, tapi di dalamnya ada entityManager soft-delete + save. Inkonsisten dengan save() yang baru saja dipasang @Transactional di commit 5ea5abb. Risiko: bila exception di tengah delete, partial state.

Detail implementasi perbaikan:
- Tambah @Transactional(propagation = REQUIRED) di delete() (sama dengan save()).
- Bila ada kafkaTemplate.send() di delete() (saat ini tidak, tapi perlu dicek untuk konsistensi): bungkus dengan afterCommit.
- Tambahkan logAndBuildFailure wrapper di catch (atau pakai advice global — lihat issue kepegawaian-g2j) untuk konsistensi.

Acceptance:
- delete() anotasi @Transactional terlihat
- Test: simulasi exception saat save delete, verifikasi tx rollback, row masih ada di DB

Lokasi: src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/services/penggajian/gajiBatchRoot/GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:165-174

title: Spring Data Redis: 54 warning 'Could not safely identify store assignment' saat boot
description:
P2 (noise): Spring Data Redis auto-detect berusaha assign SEMUA 54 JpaRepository ke Redis store (karena redis starter ada di classpath) — tapi tidak ada @RedisHash entity sama sekali. Hasilnya 54 baris warning INFO di log setiap kali boot, memenuhi log & sulit filter pesan penting.

Root cause: KepegawaianApplication.java:8-9 hanya @EnableJpaRepositories (tanpa basePackages, tanpa excludeFilters). Spring Boot defaultnya auto-config @EnableRedisRepositories(basePackages sama dengan @SpringBootApplication package = id.perumdamts.kepegawaian), sehingga scan paket repositories/ dua kali.

Konfirmasi: RedisConfig.java hanya define RedisTemplate/StringRedisTemplate — tidak ada Redis repository. spring.data.redis.repositories.enabled implicit true (default).

Detail implementasi perbaikan:
- Opsi A (config only): application.yml → spring.data.redis.repositories.enabled: false. Hilangkan 1 baris. Spring tidak akan auto-detect Redis repo. Paling minimal change.
- Opsi B (annotation): KepegawaianApplication.java → tambahkan @EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages = 'id.perumdamts.kepegawaian.repositories') DAN excludeFilters exclude semua interface. Lebih eksplisit.
- Opsi C (split package): pindahkan semua JpaRepository ke repositories/jpa/ dan JOOQ ke repositories/jooq/. Pisahkan basePackages. Overkill untuk saat ini.
- Rekomendasi: Opsi A. Tambah 1 line di application.yml. Tidak ada code change Java. Verify boot ulang → log bersih dari 54 warning.

Acceptance:
- Boot app, log tidak menampilkan 'Spring Data Redis - Could not safely identify store assignment' (atau hanya 0 baris)
- Tidak ada regresi: @Cacheable, @RedisHash (kalau ada) tetap jalan (cek: di proyek ini belum ada, jadi Opsi A aman)

Lokasi: src/main/resources/application.yml (area spring.data.redis.*) + src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/KepegawaianApplication.java:8

title: GajiBatchRoot: reprocessHandler + 4 callers need @Transactional + afterCommit
description: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.reprocessHandler() (lines 155-168) also does repository.save() + kafkaTemplate.send() outside a transaction. It's invoked by 4 public mutators (reprocess, verify1, verify2, accept) which are themselves non-transactional. Same dual-write / silent-send-failure issues as save(). Found while fixing kepegawaian-kdo and kepegawaian-48z. Apply the same pattern: @Transactional on the 4 mutators, afterCommit + whenComplete on the kafkaTemplate.send() call.

title: GajiBatchRoot: KafkaTemplate<String,Object> tapi value-serializer StringSerializer — payload non-String akan gagal serialisasi
description:
application.yml mengkonfigurasi spring.kafka.producer.value-serializer = StringSerializer, tapi bean disuntik sebagai KafkaTemplate<String, Object> (GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:37). Saat ini yang dikirim adalah save.getId() yang bertipe String (GajiBatchRoot.id adalah @Id String) sehingga KEBETULAN aman. Namun tipe generic Object menyembunyikan kontrak: jika ada yang mengirim objek non-String (mis. DTO/Long), StringSerializer akan melempar SerializationException saat runtime, bukan compile-time.

Masalah tambahan: KafkaConfig.java tidak mendefinisikan ProducerFactory/KafkaTemplate bean kustom — hanya NewTopic. Listener consumer di KafkaConfig dikomentari (baris 26-29) dan blok consumer di application.yml juga dikomentari. Artinya: tidak ada konsumen di aplikasi ini → perlu dikonfirmasi apakah konsumen ada di service eksternal (penggajian) atau memang fitur belum jalan (dead pipeline).

Rekomendasi:
1. Persempit tipe ke KafkaTemplate<String, String> agar sesuai StringSerializer dan kontrak eksplisit di compile-time; ATAU
2. Jika memang butuh kirim objek, ganti value-serializer ke JsonSerializer dan definisikan ProducerFactory yang tepat di KafkaConfig.
3. Dokumentasikan/konfirmasi keberadaan consumer (service penggajian eksternal?) — kalau tidak ada, seluruh pipeline kafka ini no-op.

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:37, config/KafkaConfig.java, application.yml:54-57. Rekomendasi saja.

title: GajiBatchRoot.save(): dual-write DB + Kafka tanpa batas transaksi — risiko pesan terkirim padahal DB rollback
description:
GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.save() TIDAK beranotasi @Transactional (bandingkan findAll() yang malah @Transactional padahal read-only). Di dalam save() ada beberapa write berurutan: repository.save(entity) (81), gajiBatchRootLampiranRepository.save() (78), processPotonganTkk.process() yang melakukan saveAll() (47), lalu kafkaTemplate.send() (81).

Masalah:
1. Tanpa @Transactional, tiap save() commit terpisah (auto-commit). Jika processPotonganTkk.process() melempar exception (RuntimeException 'Failed to process the spreadsheet file'), root + lampiran sudah ter-commit tapi proses potongan gagal → state setengah jadi.
2. kafkaTemplate.send() dipanggil setelah semua write. Bila method dibungkus @Transactional, send() async tetap bisa terbang sebelum/independen dari commit DB → pesan terkirim walau DB rollback (dual-write problem klasik).

Konteks (Spring Kafka docs via context7): untuk konsistensi DB+Kafka gunakan transactional outbox, atau ChainedKafkaTransactionManager/executeInTransaction. Minimal: bungkus seluruh save() dengan @Transactional sehingga write DB atomik, dan pindahkan/kondisikan kafka send agar hanya jalan setelah commit sukses (mis. TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization afterCommit, atau pola outbox).

Rekomendasi:
1. Tambahkan @Transactional (org.springframework) pada save() agar 3 write DB atomik.
2. Kirim Kafka di afterCommit hook ATAU implementasikan outbox table untuk reliability penuh.
3. Hapus @Transactional yang salah tempat di findAll() (read-only, lihat issue terkait).

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:52-86. Hanya rekomendasi — untuk agent implementor.

title: GajiBatchRoot: catch (Exception) menelan stack trace + @Transactional salah tempat di findAll() read-only
description:
Dua code-smell di GajiBatchRootServiceImpl yang menurunkan kualitas & observability:

1. Catch-all yang menelan exception (save, reprocess, verify1, verify2, accept — semua sama):
   catch (Exception e) { return SavedStatus.build(ESaveStatus.FAILED, e.getMessage()); }
   - Stack trace hilang (tidak ada log.error). Bug Kafka/DB jadi sulit didiagnosis — hanya pesan singkat ke client.
   - e.getMessage() bisa null (mis. NullPointerException) → client dapat pesan FAILED kosong.
   - Menangkap Exception termasuk RuntimeException tak terduga yang seharusnya bubble up.
   Rekomendasi: tambahkan logging (Slf4j log.error('...', e)) sebelum return; pertimbangkan exception handler terpusat (@RestControllerAdvice) daripada try/catch berulang di tiap method.

2. @Transactional di findAll() (baris 40) padahal method read-only — seharusnya @Transactional(readOnly = true) atau dilepas. Sebaliknya save() yang melakukan multi-write JUSTRU tidak @Transactional (lihat issue terkait dual-write). Anotasi transaksi terbalik penempatannya.

3. Catatan minor: jakarta.transaction.Transactional dipakai (import baris 18) — di Spring lebih disarankan org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional agar dukung readOnly & propagation penuh.

Lokasi: GajiBatchRootServiceImpl.java:18,40,83-85,96-98,110-112,124-126,138-140. Rekomendasi untuk agent implementor.

value: HariLibur adalah SATU-SATUNYA index master yang menyimpang dari locked index-filter contract (free-text->ilike, FK/enum/int->equal). Filter index-nya CALENDAR-SHAPED, faithful port dari kode lama (HariLiburRequest): tahun (default LocalDate.now().getYear()) + bulan (Integer, opsional) + jenisLibur (EJenisLibur, equal). Di JOOQ read query: year(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(tahun) dan month(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(bulan), bukan equal pada raw date. Alasan: kalender hari libur secara domain di-browse per tahun/bulan, bukan per tanggal persis; raw-date equal salah bentuk. Ini per-entity EXCEPTION terhadap kontrak filter index, didokumentasikan sebagai memory BUKAN ADR (faithful port perilaku yang sudah ada, trivially reversible, tidak mengejutkan untuk kalender). Deductive (no fork, silent): (1) revive-on-create ADR-0005 berlaku apa adanya, hanya native tombstone lookup-nya findAnyByTanggal(LocalDate) bukan tuple nama -> UNIQUE(tanggal); (2) jenisLibur enum->equal sudah tercakup kontrak. HariLibur tetap CRUD standar /master/hari-libur (first-class lookup, bukan dilipat). Entitas: tanggal LocalDate (UNIQUE) / jenisLibur EJenisLibur / notes String.

rewrite: mapper tetap PURE function (no repository, no I/O). Service yang resolve+validasi FK (findById.orElseThrow), lalu oper entity ter-resolve ke mapper. Mapper hanya merakit Profesi dari parameter (set FK, derive level=jab.getLevel(), set scalar). Alasan: mudah ditest, reusable lintas jalur tulis (bulk import bisa batch-load FK sendiri). Resolusi FK + error handling tetap di CommandService yang punya konteks transaksi.

Rewrite master index (GET /) JOOQ filter contract — LOCKED (pilih A).

FREE-TEXT FIELDS (nama, kode): SEMUA master index endpoint pakai case-insensitive substring LIKE '%value%' seragam. Sumber tunggal via helper, mis. Conditions.ilike(field, value) (lower(field) LIKE lower('%value%')). 

PERBAIKAN BUG: JabatanRequest lama (dto/master/jabatan/JabatanRequest.java baris 26-27) memfilter nama DAN kode via addEqual (exact match) — divergence copy-paste yang tidak disengaja; Profesi & Organisasi pakai addLike. Rewrite memperlakukan ini sebagai bug → Jabatan ikut LIKE seperti yang lain. Tidak ada request DTO/doc yang memperlakukan exactness Jabatan sebagai sengaja.

FK-ID FIELDS (organisasiId/jabatanId/levelId/gradeId/parentId): equal (sudah konsisten di semua builder lama, tidak ada keputusan).

FIELD ENUM/INT (Organisasi.category, Organisasi.levelOrg): equal (parity).

Berlaku di bawah pola Q25 terkunci (rewrite-jooq-page-query): rakit List<Condition> SEKALI termasuk Conditions.active(table) + filter dinamis ini, reuse di COUNT & ROWS.

BUKAN ADR: reversible trivial, low surprise sekali dinyatakan. Evidence: bandingkan getSpecification() di ProfesiRequest/OrganisasiRequest (addLike nama) vs JabatanRequest (addEqual nama,kode).

Rewrite master: Sanksi is a FIRST-CLASS standalone lookup, NOT folded into JenisSp (contrast APD/AlatKerja ADR-0011). Deductive resolution by ADR-0011's OWN principle: APD folded BECAUSE no standalone consumer; Sanksi HAS one — RiwayatSp (kepegawaian) carries a direct @ManyToOne Sanksi sanksi FK (RiwayatSp.java:62), so the SP-issuance form picks a Sanksi directly = needs a standalone Sanksi /list dropdown. Also PatchSanksiJenisSpRequest shows the jenisSp link is independently patchable. Therefore: (1) Sanksi keeps full standalone CRUD + own read endpoints (Option=id+nama[kode?], Detail, index ListItem); write route FLAT /master/sanksi with jenis_sp_id in body (NOT nested like APD) — Sanksi is independently meaningful, jenisSp is an optional/patchable parent link not structural ownership. (2) JenisSp Detail embeds its sanksi children via JOOQ MULTISET per locked read-dto-granularity (Detail = full incl child collections). (3) Sanksi kode UNIQUE(10) -> revive-on-create per ADR-0005 + native tombstone lookup; @Audited DROPPED (ADR-0003, master not audited). All deductive from locked ADRs — NOT a new fork, NOT an ADR.

Rewrite soft-delete: master entities sudah punya @SQLDelete+@SQLRestriction, tapi service lama deleteById pakai manual setIsDeleted(true)+save() — itu sebabnya @SQLDelete 'tidak jalan' (hanya menyala saat repository.delete()/EntityManager.remove(), bukan save). Rewrite: service Command panggil repository.delete() saja, buang set manual. Sisi baca JOOQ memintas Hibernate jadi @SQLRestriction TIDAK berlaku di JOOQ — wajib helper terpusat (Conditions.active(table)) untuk filter is_deleted=false di setiap query baca.

Rewrite DROPS the SetupMaster mechanism entirely: SetupMasterController (GET /setup-master) + all 24 Setup* services (services/setupMaster/) that hardcode master reference seed data in Java and bulk-insert at runtime. WHY: it was only a DEV convenience so user didn't refill master data manually each session. Replacement = Flyway SEED migration (dev) — consistent with ADR-0002 (Flyway = source of truth) and rewrite-drop-master-batch ('bulk seed data lives in Flyway'). NOT an ADR: pure removal + Flyway, fails hard-to-reverse leg of 3-part test. Grilling decision 2026-06-13.

JOOQ generated sources di-COMMIT ke git di src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/jooq/, regen MANUAL hanya saat skema berubah (./gradlew jooqCodegen), compileJava TIDAK depend ke codegen task. Alasan: CI = GitHub Actions FREE TIER tidak bisa jalankan container, jadi codegen wajib lokal lalu commit. Ditolak: generate-on-build gitignored (butuh Docker di CI). Disiplin: tiap PR yg ubah Flyway migration WAJIB sertakan hasil regen JOOQ di commit sama. Mengoreksi konsekuensi awal ADR-0012 (compileJava depends). Lihat ADR-0015 + ADR-0012 (sudah di-amend). Rewrite master DTO naming convention — LOCKED (pilih A). Berlaku semua entity master.

- INDEX filter object -> XQuery  (mis. Rewrite Organisasi: GET /master/organisasi/{id}/parent is KEPT by name (client compat) but re-implemented. OLD impl was a copy-paste bug: findByParentId() ignored the parent and returned the node itself via findById(id), identical to findById endpoint (OrganisasiServiceImpl.java:46-50) — never actually served a tree. NEW contract: return the node's DIRECT CHILDREN as a plain UNPAGED list (List<OrganisasiListItem>-style), i.e. children whose parent_id = {id}. Rationale: index already supports ?parentId=X (paged) for children; /{id}/parent is the convenience unpaged variant. Note the name is misleading (says 'parent', returns children) but kept to avoid breaking existing frontend callers. JOOQ read side: SELECT ... WHERE parent_id = {id} AND is_deleted=false. Master trees (Organisasi, Jabatan) are otherwise FLAT in responses: embed parent as a mini record (Q35), never nest a children[] array. Jabatan has NO /{id}/parent endpoint (its /organisasi/{id} is a legit working filter), so this quirk is Organisasi-only. Not an ADR (reversible endpoint contract, low surprise once documented).

Q30=B: rewrite mempertahankan struktur paket LAYER-FIRST proyek lama (controllers/master/, services/master/profesi/, repositories/master/, dto/master/profesi/), MENOLAK feature-first vertical slice meski tujuan rewrite menyebut 'vertical slice'. Pemisahan Command/Query tetap per-file (ProfesiCommandService/ProfesiQueryService + ProfesiQueries untuk DSL JOOQ) sesuai ADR-0001 — yang berubah hanya tempat file, bukan teknologinya. rewrite master: keunikan domain (Profesi=nama+jabatan_id+grade_id) ditegakkan via UNIQUE polos di DB + revive-on-create. Generated-column DITOLAK (repot saat backup/restore manual MariaDB). MariaDB tak punya partial unique index. CREATE: tuple bentrok dgn bangkai soft-deleted -> hidupkan bangkai (is_deleted=false + timpa field), bukan INSERT baru -> tak pernah ada 2 tuple identik shg UNIQUE polos cukup. Menemukan bangkai: NATIVE QUERY (findAnyByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeId, nativeQuery=true) krn @SQLRestriction('is_deleted=FALSE') menyembunyikan bangkai dari semua query Hibernate biasa; native tak tunduk @SQLRestriction. @SQLRestriction TETAP DIPASANG (lindungi semua jalur tulis lain spt resolusi FK findById + self-load update); JOOQ mengabaikannya by design (read pakai Conditions.active(table)) jadi BUKAN alasan menghapusnya. UPDATE: TIDAK pernah revive. Cek native findAnyByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeIdAndIdNot(id) -> jika ketemu row APAPUN (aktif/bangkai) lempar DuplicateResourceException 409. AndIdNot supaya update tanpa ubah tuple tak nabrak diri sendiri. Revive=update (updated_by/at terset), id sama. @Filter ditolak; JOOQ di command service ditolak (langgar ADR-0001). Endpoint restore-by-id opsional. Didokumentasikan di ADR-0005 + CONTEXT.md. Migration V1_0_0 harus tambah organisasi_id/jabatan_id/grade_id (belum dideklarasi), version, lalu UNIQUE(nama,jabatan_id,grade_id).

Rewrite master entities DROP @Version/version column entirely (ADR-0010). @Version is Hibernate optimistic locking, NOT audit — verified via context7 hibernate-orm: Envers (@Audited) is independent, audits via separate *_AUD tables (REV/REVTYPE), never reads version. Deductive from: (1) Envers doesn't need @Version, (2) ADR-0003 master is NOT audited, (3) Q36=A master write contract doesn't expose concurrency (last-write-wins parity). So version column would be written by Hibernate but never read/audited/checked → KISS removes it. Master Flyway migration must NOT create a version column. SCOPE GUARD: rewrite master only; old IdsAbstract untouched; penggajian/kepegawaian are audited + may have contention so @Version is a fresh decision there, NOT a blanket project-wide removal.

Q25 LOCKED — desain query halaman GET / (index) sisi JOOQ untuk ProfesiListItem, target Spring Boot 4.0.x.

(a) SORT WHITELIST: sortBy dari client TIDAK PERNAH dioper mentah ke JOOQ (jalur SQL injection / kolom invalid). Petakan via Map<String, Field<?>> eksplisit (mis. nama->PROFESI.NAMA, resiko->PROFESI.RESIKO). sortBy tak dikenal -> FALLBACK ke default deterministik PROFESI.NAMA ASC (BUKAN 400 — lebih ramah). sortDirection asc|desc.

(b) COUNT + ROWS: rakit List<Condition> SEKALI (termasuk Conditions.active(PROFESI) + filter dinamis organisasiId/jabatanId/levelId/gradeId equal, nama LIKE). Pakai ulang di dua query: satu SELECT COUNT(*), satu SELECT ... LIMIT/OFFSET. DRY, tak ada drift count vs rows.

(c) BENTUK PAGE = OPSI A (locked): ProfesiQueryService return record PageResult<T> milik kita sendiri {List<T> content, long totalElements, int totalPages, int size, int number}. BUKAN org.springframework.data.domain.Page Spring, BUKAN org.springframework.data.web.PagedModel. Alasan: sisi read sudah lepas total dari Spring Data (murni JOOQ, hitung metadata manual dari COUNT), record sendiri lebih KISS, field metadata diselaraskan gaya PagedModel agar client tetap familiar.

KONTEKS SB4 (verified via context7 v4.0.3): serialisasi org.springframework.data.domain.Page Spring secara langsung = jalur USANG (warning sejak Spring Data 3.x, struktur tak stabil) — makanya kita TIDAK pernah taruh tipe Page Spring di response. Controller lama keliru: CustomResult.any(findPage) menaruh Page<ProfesiResponse> mentah di data.

JACKSON 3 (SB4 default, wajib): PageResult.java lama pakai com.fasterxml.jackson.* (Jackson 2, DEPRECATED di SB4) + @JsonSerialize(LocalDateTimeSerializer)+@JsonFormat. Rewrite: pakai namespace Jackson 3, JsonSerializer->ValueSerializer, @JsonComponent->@JacksonComponent. Escape hatch spring.jackson.use-jackson2-defaults=true ADA tapi JANGAN dipakai di greenfield.

Rewrite master module (SB4/JOOQ read side): JOOQ Record->DTO mapping uses Records.mapping(Ctor::new) by-position for all three read DTOs (ProfesiOption, ProfesiListItem, ProfesiDetail). Type-safe at compile (constructor reference, no reflection, no annotations), official JOOQ 3.19+ idiom, composes with nested MULTISET for ProfesiDetail. DISCIPLINE: SELECT field order MUST match record constructor parameter order exactly (by-position mapping).

Rewrite sisi baca (JOOQ/CQRS): client-driven projection, satu DTO per kebutuhan endpoint — BUKAN satu response gemuk dipakai semua (keluhan asli: ProfesiResponse lama dipakai di findAll/findByJabatan/findPage/findById sekaligus, selalu load organisasi+jabatan+level+grade+apdList+alatKerjaList walau cuma butuh id+nama). Pola STANDAR berulang untuk semua master: (1) *Option = id+nama saja, query ramping tanpa join (dropdown); (2) *Detail = full termasuk koleksi anak via JOOQ MULTISET (halaman detail). Tingkat menengah (list) DISESUAIKAN per kasus. DTO baca = Java record (immutable), terpisah total dari entity JPA; berhenti pakai Lombok @Data + static from(). Koleksi anak via MULTISET (emulasi JSON_ARRAYAGG MariaDB) 1 round-trip, bukan N+1. PETA KONKRET PROFESI (Q23, locked): /list->ProfesiOption(id,nama); /{id}->ProfesiDetail(semua scalar nama/detail/resiko + organisasi/jabatan/level/grade id+nama + apdList/alatKerjaList via MULTISET); /(page index)->ProfesiListItem(id,nama,resiko + nama FK, TANPA koleksi anak); /jabatan/{id}->ProfesiOption (reuse, dropdown). Jika frontend ternyata pakai /jabatan/{id} utk tabel, naikkan ke ProfesiListItem.

Q29=A: rewrite success envelope is ONE flat Java record ApiResponse<T>(int status, String statusText, T data, Instant timestamp) used for single/list/page alike (page's data field holds the PageResult<T> record from Q25). Preserves the existing frontend JSON contract {status,statusText,data,timestamp} documented in CLAUDE.md. DROPS the old message/errors fields and the null/empty->404 logic (those move to @RestControllerAdvice + ResourceNotFoundException). status/statusText stay duplicated in JSON purely for backward-compat. Replaces the old Lombok @Data ResultAbstract/SingleResult/ListResult/PageResult hierarchy.

Feedback during /grill-with-docs rewrite design: do NOT re-ask decisions already settled in an approved ADR (e.g. sort-whitelist was already in ADR-0006 via Q30=B — re-asking it = slop). Do NOT fabricate a strawman Option B (e.g. DSL.field(rawString) SQL-injection) just to manufacture an A/B. Before posing a question: (1) grep the ADRs + prior approvals to confirm it's actually open, (2) confirm both options are ones a competent engineer would really weigh. If a detail follows deductively from an already-chosen principle (typed-exception fail-loud -> unknown sort key = 400), resolve it silently, don't vote on it. User flagged this as 'AI Slop'.

Endpoint TULIS APD & Alat Kerja BERSARANG di bawah Profesi (ADR-0011 consequence): POST /master/profesi/{profesiId}/apd, PUT /master/profesi/{profesiId}/apd/{id}, DELETE /master/profesi/{profesiId}/apd/{id} (analog /alat-kerja). profesiId dari PATH bukan body → hapus mode-gagal 'profesiId di body tidak cocok'. URL mengekspresikan kepemilikan (anak terkunci di Profesi). DITOLAK: resource datar /master/apd dgn profesiId di body (paritas klien lama) — kepemilikan jadi konvensi tersembunyi. Kode lama pakai datar /master/apd POST + /master/apd/{id} PUT/DELETE; rewrite ganti ke nested. Parent resolve getReferenceById→409 (ADR-0008). Semua mutating endpoint @PreAuthorize hasRole('ADMIN'). User pilih B.

Rewrite Command/write side attaches @ManyToOne FK (Organisasi/Jabatan/Grade) via JpaRepository#getReferenceById(id) — lazy proxy, zero SELECT, one INSERT. Bad FK = DataIntegrityViolationException at flush -> @RestControllerAdvice 409. Drops old pattern (3x findById + raw RuntimeException 'Unknown X'). Trade-off: generic FK error vs old named-FK error, accepted (admin-only low-freq master write). Verified context7 /andreipall/spring-boot-jpa: SELECT-to-set-FK is 'a performance penalty and a pointless action'. ADR-0008. Note: old code never resolved level despite levelId filter; write side follows real entity FKs not filter fields.

Rewrite master base class (MappedSuperclass) final shape, distinct from old IdsAbstract. KEEP: id (IDENTITY Long); Spring Data JPA auditing created_by/created_at + updated_by/updated_at via @CreatedDate/@CreatedBy/@LastModifiedDate/@LastModifiedBy + @EntityListeners(AuditingEntityListener.class) — Q37 keep-all-four: cheap operational forensics, parity, standard practice, independent of Envers/@Version, NOT exposed in any master response DTO; is_deleted (soft delete, CLAUDE.md mandate). DROP: @Version/version column (ADR-0010); @Audited Envers (ADR-0003, master not audited); changed_status (deductive — grep proves it's used ONLY in profil module ProfilKeluarga/Pendidikan approval workflow, never master; it leaked into shared old base). Note: Spring Data JPA auditing (created/updated inline columns) is a THIRD independent mechanism — separate from Envers (@Audited *_AUD tables) AND from @Version (optimistic lock). Q37 keeps it; ADR-0003 drops Envers; ADR-0010 drops @Version — all three orthogonal. Also: timestamps serialize via Jackson3 ISO-8601 default, NOT old @JsonFormat yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

Kategori (b) MASTER enum-backed read-only — TIDAK punya entity/tabel/JOOQ/Flyway, hanya enum di entities/commons + satu @GetMapping yang map enum.values() ke list. Anggota (5 total): StatusKerja (EStatusKerja), StatusPegawai (EStatusPegawai), JenisKontrak (EJenisKontrak), JenisMutasi (EJenisMutasi), JenisSk (EJenisSk). Semua route /master/<kebab>, GET-only, NO mutating endpoint (jadi NO @PreAuthorize). Shape lama: List<Map<String,Object>> {id: <enum constant -> Jackson serialize by name() mis 'PERPANJANGAN'>, nama: <enum.value, label Indonesia mis 'Perpanjangan Kontrak'>}. Rewrite (deductive, read-DTO principle pakai typed record bukan Map): record EnumOption(String id, String nama) di mana id=konstanta.name(), nama=konstanta.value. PENGECUALIAN: StatusPegawai punya field tambahan 'urut' -> record sendiri StatusPegawaiOption(String id, String nama, Integer urut). Enum punya field public final String value (constructor-arg). Resolusi DEDUCTIVE, no fork, no ADR. Catatan: JenisSp & Sanksi BUKAN di kategori ini — keduanya entity master tabel-backed (lihat rewrite-sanksi-jenissp-not-folded).

Rewrite read semantics (ADR-0014): GET /master/x/{id} on an absent row (never existed OR soft-deleted, hidden by @SQLRestriction is_deleted=FALSE) THROWS a typed not-found -> ADR-0013 advice renders ApiResponse status 404, data=null. NOT 200-with-data:null. Old code returned null from findById -> wrapped as 200 data:null (ProfesiServiceImpl.java:44-45); update missing -> SavedStatus.FAILED 'Unknown Profesi' (not 404); delete missing -> false. ADR-0013 already made mutating update/delete-on-missing = 404 (they go through advice); GET was the open fork because a normal null return isn't an exception. Chosen A=uniform 404 (GET/update/delete all agree 'missing'=404, REST-correct, client uses status not body null-check) over B=keep 200-null parity (rejected: read/write disagree on missing, 200 hides absence). Same typed exception as ADR-0013 -> no new advice branch. Soft-deleted reads identical to never-existing (read API hides tombstones). Applies to single-resource GET /{id} only; index/collection empty = 200 empty list. Deliberate break from old 200-null read parity.

Rewrite master: Jabatan KEEPS the nested sub-resource read endpoint GET /master/jabatan/organisasi/{id} (separate from /list). It returns a FLAT, unpaged, lightweight list (JabatanOption tier: id+nama, NOT the fat detail), filtered WHERE organisasi_id={id} AND is_deleted=false, for the cascading dropdown in the Profesi form (pick Organisasi -> list its Jabatan). This is NOT folded into /list?organisasiId even though the paged index already accepts ?organisasiId filtering -- the dropdown feeder stays its own sub-resource path. So Jabatan has TWO flat-list endpoints: /list (all) and /organisasi/{id} (filtered). Decided in rewrite-plan-grilling; not an ADR (pure code, reversible, no migration).

JOOQ codegen di rewrite TIDAK pakai plugin official org.jooq.jooq-codegen-gradle. Sebagai gantinya: satu custom Gradle task imperatif yang memanggil org.jooq.codegen.GenerationTool.generate(config) langsung. Alur (ADR-0004): start Testcontainers MariaDB -> Flyway migrate -> ambil JDBC URL live container sebagai variabel lokal -> serahkan ke GenerationTool -> stop container. Alasan: plugin official baca config jdbc.url STATIS (jooq{configuration{jdbc{url}}}), tapi Testcontainers kasih URL random tiap build -> bridging URL dinamis ke plugin butuh lazy-provider/afterEvaluate + koreografi lifecycle di sekitar task yg bukan milik kita. GenerationTool langsung = URL cuma variabel, kontrol imperatif penuh up->migrate->generate->down di satu tempat, 1:1 dgn chain ADR-0004, KISS. Dependency: org.jooq:jooq-codegen di konfigurasi jooqCodegen. Lihat ADR-0012.

Rencana rewrite modul MASTER ke Spring Boot 4 + CQRS ada di epic kepegawaian-5x7 dgn 13 child. Urutan via dep edges: F1(build.gradle.kts) -> F2(Flyway migration+seed) -> F3(JOOQ codegen GenerationTool). F1 juga -> F4(foundation: ApiResponse/PageResult/RestControllerAdvice/typed-exc) & F5(MasterBaseEntity+Security7). F2+F3+F4+F5 -> E0(Golongan EXEMPLAR, template kanonik). E0 -> E1(8 flat) E2(Organisasi) E3(Jabatan) E4(Grade) E6(JenisSp+Sanksi). E3 -> E5(Profesi aggregate, APD/AlatKerja MULTISET). E7(5 enum read-only) hanya butuh F4. bd ready surfaces F1 dulu. Tiap issue: gitnexus understand-first + impact upstream, context7 sebelum coding, DRY+KISS, scope ketat (no AI slop), patuh ADR 0001-0015.

Master read DTOs: the self-referential parent reference (Organisasi.parent, Jabatan.parent) gets its OWN mini record preserving {id, kode, nama, shortName} — NOT collapsed to the uniform RefItem(id,nama). Reason: old API already returns parent.kode + parent.shortName; collapsing would silently drop two response fields (breaking change). Cheap via JOOQ self-join. RefItem(id,nama) stays only for true id+nama-only refs (Profesi APD/alat-kerja children). Decided in grilling Q35=A.

Rewrite master: ONE request record per entity (e.g. ProfesiRequest), used by BOTH save (POST /master/x) and update (PUT /master/x/{id}). id always from path variable, never in body. Rationale: in old code every master XPutRequest is an EMPTY subclass of XPostRequest (zero added fields, identical validation); Golongan/Grade/Level already share a single PostRequest. Records cannot extend, so keeping Post/Put split would mean copy-pasting all fields+annotations into a second record for no behavioral difference. DRY+KISS -> collapse to one. NOT an ADR (splitting later is a trivial forward change). Validation annotations live on the single record's components. Create-vs-update divergence handled in the Service layer (revive-on-create ADR-0005 affects only Profesi command path, not DTO shape), not via separate DTOs.

REVISI (ADR-0011): APD & Alat Kerja di rewrite = CQRS ASIMETRIS. Sisi TULIS TETAP punya endpoint per-anak: CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE tiap APD/Alat Kerja (mutasi granular satu row ber-id) — FE butuh ubah/hapus/tambah satu item tanpa kirim ulang seluruh list. Sisi BACA TIDAK punya endpoint standalone: tak ada GET index/list/{id}; APD/Alat Kerja muncul HANYA di ProfesiDetail via JOOQ MULTISET (di FE selalu tampil bersama Profesi). DITOLAK: (a) CRUD penuh standalone (GET standalone = permukaan mati), (b) replace-all child-list di tulis Profesi (FE perlu mutasi granular). DELETE per-anak = SOFT-delete (is_deleted=true) sesuai aturan global; MULTISET filter is_deleted=false. Apd/AlatKerja butuh @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction sendiri di rewrite. CREATE/UPDATE terima profesiId (path/body), parent resolve getReferenceById→409 (ADR-0008). Mapper pure. Migration V1_0_0 harus tambah tabel apd & alat_kerja (id, profesi_id FK, nama, audit, is_deleted) — saat ini BELUM ADA. Hanya Apd/AlatKerjaCommandService, tak ada QueryService standalone. Alasan user: 'tetap butuh CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE, hanya FE tdk butuh GET tersendiri karena ditampilkan bersama profesi'.

Rewrite (SB4, master-first): services are concrete @Service classes — NO interface+Impl split. Best practice (verified via context7/Spring Boot docs): constructor injection + @ComponentScan recommended; return concrete types for max type info; Spring never mandates an interface for single-impl beans. Old code had 55 interfaces / 53 Impl, all 1:1, none with a 2nd impl — dead polymorphism. CQRS pairs ProfesiCommandService (JPA write) + ProfesiQueryService (JOOQ read) both concrete. See docs/adr/0007-concrete-services-no-interface.md. KISS/YAGNI: extract interface later if a real 2nd impl appears.

Rewrite master module DROPS the POST /{x}/batch endpoint that 10 old master controllers expose (AlasanBerhenti, JenisPelatihan, JenisKeahlian, JenjangPendidikan, JenisKitas, Grade, Golongan, Jabatan, Organisasi, Level). Profesi never had batch. WHY: old saveBatch (e.g. OrganisasiServiceImpl:67-75) was all-or-nothing repository.saveAll with NO duplicate-check and NO FK validation (bad parentId silently -> null), always returned SUCCESS -- materially looser than single save (revive-on-create ADR-0005, FK->409 ADR-0008, dup->409). Rewrite keeps ONLY the single validated POST. Bulk seed data lives in Flyway migrations (ADR-0002 = Flyway source of truth). NOT an ADR: re-adding endpoints is pure code, no migration, so fails the hard-to-reverse leg of the 3-part test. RISK: an unverified frontend bulk-add UI would break -- route_map indexes only this backend so frontend consumers can't be confirmed. Grilling decision 2026-06-12.

rewrite ProfesiDetail (GET /{id}) sisi baca JOOQ: pakai SATU record RefItem(Long id, String nama) seragam untuk semua FK (organisasi, jabatan, level, grade) DAN untuk elemen koleksi anak (apdList, alatKerjaList) — DRY krn semua bentuknya identik {id,nama}. Anak Apd & AlatKerja di kode lama cuma {id,nama}+profesi_id, extend IdsAbstract (punya is_deleted+@Version). Profesi.@OneToMany apdList/alatKerjaList TANPA cascade/orphanRemoval, dan ProfesiPostRequest/PutRequest TIDAK memuat anak -> BATAS AGREGAT: Apd/AlatKerja adalah agregat MANDIRI, ditulis lewat endpoint Apd/AlatKerja sendiri, BUKAN menembus Profesi. ProfesiDetail hanya MEMBACA anak. apdList+alatKerjaList diisi via JOOQ MULTISET (1 round-trip) dan WAJIB difilter Conditions.active(APD)/Conditions.active(ALAT_KERJA) krn JOOQ memintas Hibernate shg @SQLRestriction tak berlaku — tanpa filter, anak terhapus ikut muncul. level tetap ditampilkan (turunan jabatan).

rewrite write-side error handling: command service tulis happy-path saja, LEMPAR exception bertipe (ResourceNotFoundException->404 untuk FK/id tak ada; DuplicateResourceException->409). Satu @RestControllerAdvice memetakan exception->ErrorResult dgn status benar, DAN menyerap MethodArgumentNotValidException shg blok 'if(errors.hasErrors())' per-controller DIHAPUS (DRY). Pensiunkan ESaveStatus/SavedStatus/SavedResult di sisi tulis; respons sukses save = CustomResult.any(dto) 201. Sisi BACA tetap pakai CustomResult.any/list/page utk respons sukses. Catatan jujur: pola lama SavedResult sebenarnya sudah map SUCCESS->201/DUPLICATE->409/FAILED->400, jadi alasan ganti BUKAN status salah, tapi: hapus try/catch(Exception) yg menelan semua jadi FAILED+bocorkan e.getMessage mentah, dan bedakan 404 FK-not-found dari 400.

rewrite: write-side mapping pakai mapper terpisah (mis. ProfesiMapper), BUKAN static toEntity di request DTO. Alasan: reusable untuk jalur tulis lain (bulk/import) di kemudian hari. Request DTO jadi record pasif (field + validasi Jakarta saja). Cek duplikat pindah ke CommandService pakai derived repository method (existsByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeId), bukan Specification/JOOQ. Derive level=jabatan.getLevel() tetap diterapkan saat mapping.

APD & Alat Kerja: TIDAK ada UNIQUE constraint, duplikat nama per Profesi DIIZINKAN (user pilih A, KISS). POST selalu plain INSERT — TIDAK ada revive-on-create (ADR-0005 hanya untuk Profesi yg punya domain-key nama+jabatan+grade; APD tak punya key semacam itu). Soft-deleted 'helm' tetap tombstone; POST 'helm' lagi = row aktif BARU. Cocok dgn skema lama (Apd/AlatKerja cuma @Index(nama)+@Index(is_deleted), tanpa UNIQUE). Konsekuensi: satu Profesi BISA punya dua row 'helm' aktif — itu data-quality/UI concern (admin-curated, list kecil, hapus salah satu), BUKAN constraint DB. Tidak membangun mesin tombstone-revival utk value-child. Bounds klausa soft-delete di ADR-0011 (DELETE per-anak tetap soft-delete; hanya CREATE yg plain-insert tanpa cek duplikat).

Rewrite build.gradle.kts (Spring Boot 4.0.3) keeps the io.spring.dependency-management plugin (version 1.1.4) rather than the Gradle-native platform(SpringBootPlugin.BOM_COORDINATES) import. plugins { id("org.springframework.boot") version "4.0.3"; id("io.spring.dependency-management") version "1.1.4" }. Reason: it is still the documented SB 4.0.3 default (context7-verified), gives Maven-style transitive managed-version forcing that JOOQ/Flyway/Testcontainers benefit from, and matches the old build for lowest team surprise. platform() BOM only constrains versions Gradle resolves (no transitive forcing); its one-fewer-plugin saving was too marginal. SB 4.0.0 brings Spring Framework 7.0.1 + Spring Security 7.0.0. Not an ADR: documented default, low-surprise, trivially reversible — fails the hard-to-reverse/surprising test.

CustomResult envelope 'timestamp' field in the SB4 rewrite is an Instant, serialized by Jackson 3 as ISO-8601 by default. Drop the old Jackson-2 '@JsonFormat(pattern="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")' / LocalDateTimeSerializer entirely — those won't compile under Jackson 3 (tools.jackson.* namespace) anyway. Rationale: timestamp is a machine-readable server-response marker; ISO-8601 Instant is unambiguous and zero-config.

Rewrite error path (ADR-0013): a single @RestControllerAdvice translates typed exceptions into the SAME ApiResponse<Object>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope as success — NOT Spring 7's framework-default ProblemDetail/RFC 9457. Mapping: MethodArgumentNotValidException->400 with data=list of 'field : message' strings (parity with old ErrorResult.build(Errors)); bad-FK EntityNotFoundException from getReferenceById->409 (ADR-0008); not-found on update/delete->404; data=null for 409/404. Old code had NO @ControllerAdvice anywhere — every controller threaded Errors and returned ErrorResult.build(errors) inline (400-only, no throw). That inline pattern is REJECTED (can't reach 409/404). Centralization is forced; the fork resolved was envelope SHAPE. Chosen A=symmetric ApiResponse (one shape client-wide, KISS, FE never consumes RFC9457 type URIs) over B=ProblemDetail (rejected: two shapes per outcome). Controllers stop returning ErrorResult inline -> they throw, advice shapes body. Advice is a foundation-slice artifact built alongside ApiResponse/PageResult before any master endpoint. Verified SB4/Spring7 ProblemDetail default via context7.

Rewrite master (ProfesiDetail read side): apdList + alatKerjaList loaded via JOOQ MULTISET. On MariaDB MULTISET is emulated as group_concat(json_array(...) SEPARATOR ',') -> JSON; NO native MULTISET. KNOWN GOTCHA: MariaDB group_concat_max_len default = 1024 bytes/group; if a profesi's children JSON exceeds it MariaDB SILENTLY TRUNCATES -> malformed JSON -> JOOQ parse error (not graceful empty list). DECISION (Q27=A): keep MULTISET, rely on default, do NOT raise group_concat_max_len. Justification: APD + Alat Kerja per profesi are always small bounded lists (handful of {id,nama}), KISS. Documented assumption in CONTEXT.md. Revisit only if a real profesi ever exceeds the limit (then switch to SET SESSION group_concat_max_len).

Rewrite master simple lookups (Level, JenisKeahlian, JenisKitas, JenisPelatihan, AlasanBerhenti, RumahDinas, JenjangPendidikan, Golongan + richer HariLibur/JenisSp/Sanksi): PER-ENTITY CONCRETE classes (Q chose A), NOT a generic AbstractMasterCrudService/Controller. Each gets own XCommandService(JPA write)+XQueryService(JOOQ read)+controller+records+mapper, structurally identical to Profesi/Grade just thinner. DRY honored at FINE grain via shared building blocks (base @MappedSuperclass entity per rewrite-master-base-class, ApiResponse/PageResult, Conditions.active(table), filter->condition helpers) NOT a god-generic control-flow skeleton. Rationale: genericizable surface (command orchestration) is small; non-genericizable surface is large — JOOQ read side inherently per-table (generated table classes, hand-built projections), per-entity field divergence (Golongan has NO nama -> golongan+pangkat; JenjangPendidikan +seq/isStatistik; RumahDinas +nilai Double; AlasanBerhenti +notes), and only Level carries UNIQUE(nama) -> revive-on-create per ADR-0005 while the other 7 flat lookups are non-unique. A generic base would force a revive override hook eroding uniformity = exactly what KISS warns against. Consistent w/ ADR-0006 layer-first + ADR-0007 concrete-no-interface. Read tier follows locked standard (rewrite-read-dto-granularity): Option=id+nama, Detail=all scalars no children/MULTISET, index=ListItem. NOT an ADR (reversible: extract base later if real duplication pain appears; follows deductively from KISS+ADR-0006/0007).

Rewrite master index-filter DTO 'XQuery' is an immutable Java record (NOT mutable @Data like old CommonPageRequest). Spring 6.1+ DataBinder binds query params into record constructors (context7-verified), incl. nested structures + @BindParam. Pagination fields are NOT inheritable since records can't extend a base class, so a single shared record PageQuery(int page, int size, String sortBy, String sortDirection) is COMPOSED into each XQuery, e.g. record ProfesiQuery(Long organisasiId, Long jabatanId, Long levelId, Long gradeId, String nama, PageQuery page). Query params get a 'page.' prefix (?page.size=20&page.sortBy=nama&organisasiId=3). DRY: pagination defined+defaulted once. Replaces old XRequest extends CommonPageRequest + getSpecification(). NOT an ADR (reversible, low surprise). Relates to rewrite-master-dto-naming, rewrite-jooq-page-query.

Rewrite master write-success response body = MINIMAL ACK, never a Detail DTO. POST /master/x -> 201 with ApiResponse.data = { id } (the created id). PUT /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = { id } (echoes path var). DELETE /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = null. Keeps the Q29 ApiResponse<T>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope on ALL endpoints (rejected bare 201/204 no-envelope for that reason). RATIONALE: old success body was a throwaway String ('Organisasi Saved') stuffed into data, never the entity -- so returning id-only is parity, not a loss. CRITICAL CQRS reason: the command service is JPA-ONLY and must NEVER call the JOOQ query service to assemble a Detail DTO on write -- that would couple the two CQRS sides on every mutation. Client re-GETs the Detail tier (/master/x/{id}) if it needs the full server-resolved record (e.g. level copied from Jabatan per ADR-0009). DUPLICATE/FAILED paths already handled by typed exceptions + @RestControllerAdvice (DuplicateResourceException->409, ResourceNotFoundException->404). NOT an ADR: reversible forward change, no surprising trade-off beyond the CQRS-split reasoning already captured.
